description.default: Two agent tools: download a web file into workspace assets, and upload an asset to any URL — non-whitelisted targets ask for confirmation first and can be whitelisted/blacklisted in one click. Credentials stay in SiYuan's secret store, never in the chat or logs.
description.zh_CN: 为思源 Agent 增加上传/下载两个工具：把网络文件下载存入工作空间附件；把附件上传到指定链接，非白名单地址会先弹窗确认，可一键加入白/黑名单。凭据存于思源密钥库，不进对话与日志。
